title: Growing Up
about: Realizing the world was bigger than I imagined through friendships and shared laughter at State Arts-In.
description: This track reflects on one of the unexpected ways State Arts-In changed me. Coming from a sheltered upbringing, I found myself surrounded by friends who introduced me to jokes, perspectives, and conversations I'd never encountered before. Through laughter, embarrassment, and trust, I began to understand that growing up isn't always dramatic—sometimes it happens one conversation at a time with people who care about you.
